budget.expected_bytes_note: about 3 MB: Stage 1 D5 averaged 34.6 KB for up to 433 rows
budget.seconds_note: at one request per second; a Retry-After of up to 300 s replaces the backoff of that request

classes.discarded: open, high, low, volume, turnover of every row, and the close of every other row, unparsed; the two closes are reduced to their log ratio and are not kept
classes.name: proxy_hourly_trade
classes.note: one page per primary V1 episode; a row outside the requested range stops the run
classes.params: category=linear, symbol, interval=60, start=A-1h, end=B-1h, limit=200
classes.parsed: per row: column 1 (the bar start time) and the row length; of the two rows that start at A-1h and B-1h only: column 5 (the close)

decision_table.condition: defined proxies below 95% of the 228 episodes (defined * 100 < 95 * 228)
decision_table.consequence: stop code incomplete_coverage; no statistic emitted; no return read

decision_table.condition: fewer than 100 defined episodes, or fewer than 26 ISO weeks with one
decision_table.consequence: stop code insufficient_events; no statistic emitted; no return read

decision_table.condition: zero or non-finite variance, a draw without an episode, or a block longer than the week sequence
decision_table.consequence: no MDE statement; stage 4 closed under this contract; no return read

decision_table.condition: gate MDE = 2.80 * SE with DEFF = max(largest of blocks 2, 4, 8; 1.0) is above 400 bps (unrounded)
decision_table.consequence: stop code insufficient_power; I25 stops; no return is read

decision_table.condition: gate MDE at or below 400 bps
decision_table.consequence: stage 4 may be proposed: its own contract, request list, hash and registry row, then the owner's separate go; nothing about an effect is implied

estimand.closes: C(t) is the close of the 1 h trade bar that starts at t - 1 h
estimand.never_read: any bar that starts after B - 1 h, any bar at or after E, the entry bar, any exit, any bar from the cut

limits.api_error_rule: an HTTP 200 envelope with retCode other than 0 records only its retCode and retMsg (200 characters at most); 10006 and 10018 are rate limits (retried, the spacing doubles), 10000 and 10016 are transient (retried), any other code stops the run naming it; retCode must be an integer, never a boolean or a float; a wrong envelope shape stops the run as a schema mismatch
limits.persisted_stop: stop.json ends the root; nothing continues in it
limits.restart: a fresh root per contract; a resumed root must carry the same binding (contract hash, prior usage, code revision and file hashes), else it is refused

cohort.source: primary V1 episodes of the sealed Stage 1 run, derived locally and checked against the reviewed report before any request

request.params: category=linear, symbol, interval=60, start=A-1h, end=B-1h, limit=200
request.row_rule: a row starting outside [A-1h, B-1h], a duplicate start, a page of 200 rows, a wrong symbol or a bad close stops the run as a schema mismatch
request.undefined_proxy: the bar at A-1h or at B-1h is absent; no imputation

retention.public: the allowlisted aggregate report only: no symbol, date, close, per-launch value, mean, sign, quantile, minimum or maximum
retention.sealed_root: 0700 outside Git: attempts, receipts (the log return of each episode is the only price-derived value), cohort.json, run.json, stop.json

windows.note: every request ends before E of its episode, and E + 7 d is at or before the cut; nothing dated from the cut or from the blind window is requested
